projects.title: BLACK Xbox Static Recompilation for Apple Silicon macOS
projects.platform: Original Xbox (2006; region/revision not stated) → macOS Apple Silicon arm64
projects.status: Playable through the first mission: the port reaches the title, plays intro videos, and supports movement, aiming, shooting, reloading, and objectives. Startup remains unstable during video playback (README estimates about one run in three); camera drift and silent audio from a DSP stub remain. No full-game completion is claimed.
projects.summary: Statically translates Xbox x86 functions to C and builds a native arm64 macOS executable using the required xboxrecomp runtime. Graphics use the xemu-derived NV2A renderer; an optional ANGLE/Metal backend is documented. Users must provide their own legally obtained disc; no game code or assets are included.
projects.strategy: Function-by-function static Xbox x86-to-C recompilation using xboxrecomp; native Apple Silicon host with xemu-derived NV2A graphics runtime
projects.source_available: Public source; requires the user's own legally obtained Xbox disc and the separate xboxrecomp runtime; no game binaries or assets are included.
projects.subtype: Original Xbox static recompilation for macOS

Build and setup use the player's own disc image; tested USA Redump ISO and Europe/Australia XISO hashes are documented. The fork's custom runtime changes are required for its current behavior.
projects.strategy: Static Xbox CPU recompilation via xboxrecomp with a Direct3D 11 renderer; maintained fork of MattSG/mm3-recomp
projects.source_available: Public source and build scripts; requires the user's own supported Midtown Madness 3 disc/image; game data and build outputs are not included.

projects.title: Project 1944: Call of Duty 3 Xbox 360 Recompilation
projects.platform: Xbox 360 (USA/Europe; Title ID 415607E1, Media ID 2E07093A) → Windows 10/11 x64, Direct3D 12
projects.status: Native Windows release v2.0. The documented campaign test scope is the first Saint-Lô mission, checkpoint save/load, and a 120 Hz timing trace on one PC; the full campaign and other hardware are unverified. The v2.0 release adds a separately recompiled multiplayer executable and networking features, with the README identifying remaining test limitations.
projects.summary: An independent Call of Duty 3 PC implementation that statically recompiles Xbox 360 PowerPC code to C++ with ReXGlue and builds a native Windows x64 host, using Xenia-derived kernel and graphics layers. The user supplies a matching Xbox 360 ISO, extracted default.xex, or supported Games on Demand package; the supported default.xex hash is checked locally. No game files or generated game code are kept in the repository.
projects.strategy: Xbox 360 PowerPC-to-C++ static recompilation with ReXGlue; native Windows host and Xenia-derived kernel/graphics components
projects.source_available: Public source plus v2.0 release; requires the user's own supported USA/Europe Xbox 360 game copy; no game or generated game code is included.

projects.title: Uncharted: Drake's Fortune (Nathan Drake Collection) Native PC Port
projects.game: Uncharted: Drake's Fortune (The Nathan Drake Collection, PS4)
projects.platform: PlayStation 4 → Windows 10/11 x64 and Linux x86-64 (the Linux port is a fork of the Windows project)
projects.status: Windows v0.3.3 release with a separate Linux fork. The Linux README says this title boots and renders and identifies its collection executable; the Windows project launches all three games. Known streaming/render crashes remain in Uncharted 2 and 3 on the documented US v1.02 dump, and neither project claims a full play-through.
projects.summary: Native host port of the PS4 collection's original game code, with PS4 graphics translated to Vulkan through the bbport/shadPS4-derived stack; it is not run through Wine or a conventional PS4 emulator. This row covers the eboot.bin target for Uncharted: Drake's Fortune. The user must provide a decrypted collection dump; CUSA02320 is documented by the Linux fork and the Windows README lists it among supported examples. No game files are included.
projects.strategy: Direct execution of original PS4 game code through a native host/runtime with Vulkan graphics translation (bbport/shadPS4-derived)
projects.source_available: Public Windows source and v0.3.3 release plus a public Linux fork; requires the user's own decrypted PS4 collection dump; game data is not included.
projects.programming_language: C++ (Linux fork also uses a Python/Tk launcher)
projects.subtype: PS4-to-PC native API translation; executable target eboot.bin
